outputs.per_minute: Silent pauses per minute of recording (1/min)
outputs.ratio: Share of silent pause time in the recording length (%)
outputs.std: Standard deviation of silent pause duration (ms)
outputs.long_count: Number of silent pauses of at least long_pause (-)
outputs.long_median: Median duration of silent pauses of at least long_pause (ms); NaN when there is none

merge_adjacent.description: Merge adjacent segments into one; default False = every segment separately as in the legacy module

trim_edges.description: Ignore segments before the first speech and after the last; the recording length used for shares and counts per minute is shortened accordingly. False = as in the legacy module

min_pause.description: Shortest segment that is counted (s); default 0 = all

long_pause.description: Threshold for the long_count and long_median columns (s)
